title: Italo-Disco
lyrics:
Sapete una cosa? L'amore e i sentimenti, l'attrazione e il contatto, sono cose stupende.
Màrzia e Fabìola, oggi cantano così

[Verse 1]
In the sunshine, we dance and play
Two hearts beating, in a loving way
We share our dreams, our hopes, our fears
Together forever, through all the years

[Chorus]
Together we are two special women
Hand in hand, our love shines bright
Together we are two special women
A bond of love, that will never die

[Verse 2]
We laugh, we cry, we live, we love
In each other's arms, we find our home above
Our love is pure, our love is true
A love that will last, forever anew

[Chorus]
Together we are two special women
Hand in hand, our love shines bright
Together we are two special women
A bond of love, that will never die

[Bridge]
Life may take us, on different paths
But our love will guide us, through the dark
We'll hold on tight, to what we've found
A love that's strong, and forever bound

[Verse 3]
In the silence, we hear our hearts beat
A rhythm of love, that can't be beat
We cherish each moment, we share our soul
Together forever, our love will make us whole

[Chorus]
Together we are two special women
Hand in hand, our love shines bright
Together we are two special women
A bond of love, that will never die

[Verse 4]
Through life's ups and downs, we'll stand as one
Our love will shine, like the morning sun
We'll support each other, through every test
Together forever, our love will be the best

[Verse 5]
Our love is a flame, that burns so bright
A guiding light, in the dark of night
We'll follow our hearts, and never let go
Together forever, our love will grow

[Chorus]
Together we are two special women
Hand in hand, our love shines bright
Together we are two special women
A bond of love, that will never die

A bond of love, that will never die
A bond of love, that will never die
A bond of love, that will never die
A bond of love, that will never die
A bond of love, that will never die
A bond of love, that will never die
A bond of love, that will never die
A bond of love, that will never die
A bond of love, that will never die
